ethical_issue: Comprehension testing must not embarrass or blame users
Status testing may collect sensitive user anxiety and behavior signals
Early adopter testing excludes constrained and skeptical users
Scale simulation may obscure burden on frontline staff
Public-service pilot requires strong consent access privacy and redress
Executive showcase uses no participant protection because no real test exists
Frontline role-play must protect staff from blame
Community tabletop requires participation power and feedback accountability
